description: MassGIS 2000 Massachusetts Solid Waste Facilities (Polygons) (December 1997) is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Massachusetts. Dept. of Environmental Management. The datalayer contains the majority of the facilities currently regulated under DEP's solid waste regulations (310 CMR 16.00 & 19.00). The 579 polygons in the datalayer include thirteen specific types of solid waste facilities. Please Note: Although the majority of the polygons represent landfills, only a small fraction of those landfills are active. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For non-commercial use only.. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
